about.title:
BUILT FOR PEOPLE

WHO SHOW UP
about.intro: El Captain connects people who want to train with independent coaches who run group sessions and private coaching. One place to find a session, book it, and keep track of your training.

members.title: FOR MEMBERS
members.l1: Browse group sessions and one to one coaching by discipline and time.
members.l2: Book and cancel without phone calls or DMs.
members.l3: Keep a history of every session and coach you’ve trained with.

coaches.title: FOR COACHES
coaches.l1: Publish sessions with capacity, pricing, and a schedule view.
coaches.l2: See who’s booked and who keeps coming back.
coaches.l3: Get paid out without chasing invoices.

book.q: How do I book a session?
book.a: Create a free account, pick a session, and tap Reserve. You’ll get a confirmation by email and the session shows up under My sessions.

cancel.a: Yes. Cancel from My sessions up to 12 hours before the start for a full refund. Later cancellations follow the coach’s policy.

types.q: What’s the difference between group and private sessions?
types.a: Group sessions have a fixed time and capacity. Private sessions are one to one with a coach and reserve the full slot for you.

becomeCoach.q: How do I become a coach?
becomeCoach.a: Register as a coach and complete your profile. Our team reviews applications, usually within two business days.

payouts.a: Payouts go out weekly to the account in your coach profile, minus the platform fee.

fee.a: No. Members pay per session; coaches pay a percentage only on completed bookings.
